subject.title: Add openclaw/openclaw-facetime as an official ClawSweeper target

question: Should `openclaw/openclaw-facetime` become an officially supported production review target, with the operational commitment to maintain its dispatcher, validation contract, and plugin-specific safety guidance?
rationale: This adds a new cross-repository production integration and requires external repository access, secrets, and ongoing ownership; source-level automation cannot safely decide that operational commitment.

options.title: Sponsor official onboarding
options.body: Approve the explicit target profile and coordinate the FaceTime repository dispatcher, app access, secret access, and end-to-end validation.

options.title: Keep manual fallback only
options.body: Retain generic manually dispatched review support until an owner commits to maintaining the target-side integration.

options.title: Request a narrower pilot
options.body: Run a time-bounded dispatcher and exact-event proof on the existing implementation PR before adding scheduled dashboard coverage.

recommendation.title: Sponsor official onboarding
recommendation.body: Approve the explicit target profile and coordinate the FaceTime repository dispatcher, app access, secret access, and end-to-end validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy identifies Peter as the available operational escalation point for ClawSweeper workflow decisions; feature-history ownership could not be independently established.
